name: On-premises and virtual network connectivity for Eventstream connectors
description: Eventstream connectors can now reach data sources that sit on-premises or inside a private virtual network. This closes a common gap for enterprises whose databases and message brokers are not exposed to the public internet, letting them stream that data into Microsoft Fabric securely.With this capability, you can:- Connect Eventstream to sources behind a corporate firewall or in a private network.- Keep traffic on private network paths to meet security and compliance needs.
